description: This file defines the 'SwipeRefreshListFragment' class, a subclass of ListFragment that integrates Android's SwipeRefreshLayout to provide 'pull-to-refresh' functionality in a list fragment.

classes.name: SwipeRefreshListFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that encapsulates a ListView wrapped with SwipeRefreshLayout for pull-to-refresh support.

classes.name: ListFragmentSwipeRefreshLayout
classes.description: A custom subclass of SwipeRefreshLayout that overrides canChildScrollUp() to properly detect when the ListView can scroll up, enabling swipe-to-refresh gesture.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the view hierarchy for the fragment, wrapping the ListView with a SwipeRefreshLayout.

methods.name: setOnRefreshListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to be invoked when a swipe-to-refresh gesture is initiated.

methods.name: isRefreshing
methods.description: Checks whether a refresh operation is currently in progress.

methods.name: setRefreshing
methods.description: Programmatically sets the refreshing state of the SwipeRefreshLayout.

methods.name: setColorScheme
methods.description: Configures the color scheme of the refresh indicator.

methods.name: getSwipeRefreshLayout
methods.description: Returns the SwipeRefreshLayout instance used in this fragment.
